import sys
import math

class TaskG:
    MAX_N = 1 << 21
    cs = [0.0] * MAX_N
    sn = [0.0] * MAX_N
    csi = [0.0] * MAX_N
    sni = [0.0] * MAX_N

    # static initializer
    _initialized = False
    @classmethod
    def _init_tables(cls):
        if cls._initialized:
            return
        cls._initialized = True
        length = 1
        while length <= cls.MAX_N:
            half = length // 2
            for i in range(half, length):
                angle = 2 * math.pi * (i - half) / length
                cls.cs[i] = math.cos(angle)
                cls.sn[i] = math.sin(angle)
                cls.csi[i] = math.cos(-angle)
                cls.sni[i] = math.sin(-angle)
            length <<= 1

    @staticmethod
    def fft(a, b, inverse):
        n = len(a)
        # bit-reversal permutation
        bits = n.bit_length() - 1
        for i in range(1, n):
            j = 0
            x = i
            for _ in range(bits):
                j = (j << 1) | (x & 1)
                x >>= 1
            if i < j:
                a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i]
                b[i], b[j] = b[j], b[i]

        length = 2
        while length <= n:
            half = length // 2
            for i in range(0, n, length):
                w = TaskG.MAX_N // length
                for j in range(half):
                    k = w * j
                    wA = TaskG.csi[half + j] if inverse else TaskG.cs[half + j]
                    wB = TaskG.sni[half + j] if inverse else TaskG.sn[half + j]
                    uA = a[i + j]
                    uB = b[i + j]
                    vA = a[i + j + half] * wA - b[i + j + half] * wB
                    vB = a[i + j + half] * wB + b[i + j + half] * wA
                    a[i + j] = uA + vA
                    b[i + j] = uB + vB
                    a[i + j + half] = uA - vA
                    b[i + j + half] = uB - vB
            length <<= 1

        if inverse:
            for i in range(n):
                a[i] /= n
                b[i] /= n

    @staticmethod
    def multiply_mod(a, b, mod):
        need = len(a) + len(b) - 1
        n = 2
        while n < need:
            n <<= 1

        a_real = [0.0] * n
        a_imag = [0.0] * n
        for i, val in enumerate(a):
            x = val % mod
            if x < 0:
                x += mod
            a_real[i] = float(x & ((1 << 15) - 1))
            a_imag[i] = float(x >> 15)

        b_real = [0.0] * n
        b_imag = [0.0] * n
        for i, val in enumerate(b):
            x = val % mod
            if x < 0:
                x += mod
            b_real[i] = float(x & ((1 << 15) - 1))
            b_imag[i] = float(x >> 15)

        TaskG.fft(a_real, a_imag, False)
        TaskG.fft(b_real, b_imag, False)

        fa_real = [0.0] * n
        fa_imag = [0.0] * n
        fb_real = [0.0] * n
        fb_imag = [0.0] * n

        for i in range(n):
            j = (n - i) & (n - 1)

            a1r = (a_real[i] + a_real[j]) / 2.0
            a1i = (a_imag[i] - a_imag[j]) / 2.0
            a2r = (a_imag[i] + a_imag[j]) / 2.0
            a2i = (a_real[j] - a_real[i]) / 2.0

            b1r = (b_real[i] + b_real[j]) / 2.0
            b1i = (b_imag[i] - b_imag[j]) / 2.0
            b2r = (b_imag[i] + b_imag[j]) / 2.0
            b2i = (b_real[j] - b_real[i]) / 2.0

            fa_real[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r
            fa_imag[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i

            fb_real[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i
            fb_imag[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r

        TaskG.fft(fa_real, fa_imag, True)
        TaskG.fft(fb_real, fb_imag, True)

        res = [0] * need
        for i in range(need):
            aa = int(round(fa_real[i]))
            bb = int(round(fb_real[i]))
            cc = int(round(fa_imag[i]))
            res[i] = int((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod)
        return res

    def solve(self, test_number, inp, out):

        n, k = map(int, inp.readline().split())
        v = [0] * 10

        res = 0

        out.write(str(res) + '\n')

def main():

    solver = TaskG()
    inp = sys.stdin
    out = sys.stdout
    solver.solve(1, inp, out)
